== Strategy ==

Strategy and Implementation:The point of this deck is to Force drain the Light Side as soon as you can so it hurts them bad. Try to use Piett's game text in a big way so you can send your Probe Droids down undercover. Don't wait, do it as soon as you can. Stick the TIEs at the Big One to drain, but even though they will be lost due to asteroid destiny.

Good Luck, And May The Force Be With You.

Q: Tell us about yourself...

A: My Name is Thomas Dowling, I'm 13 years old and I live in Ottawa, Ontario, Canada. I'm in Grade 9 at Merivale High School. I have one Brother who is 11 years old and he also plays Star Wars CCG.

Q: How did you become interested in the game?

I became interested in Star Wars CCG when one day my friend Mike Henderson bought a starter deck (and got a Darth Vader) and he said, "You wanna play this game?" He gave me his Light cards and the rule book, and the moment I read the rule book I was hooked.

Q: Do you have a mentor to help you with gameplay and deck design?

A: I had a mentor, Ross Renaud. He aided me with my decks when I first started.

Q: Where do you play?

I usually play at a store called Kool Kards Heaven, where most of our tournaments are held. And there is also a weekly league every Saturday at Kool Kards, where I'm a frequent player.

Q: What do you like best about working with a forty card deck?

A: The thing I like about the 40 Card deck is that it moves so fast. Also, with a 40 card deck you depend on luck alot more than you do with a 60 card deck. It adds a bit more fun to play.

Q: Have you played in a regular sanctioned Swiss tournament?

A: I have played in many Swiss tournaments, including both World Championship qualifiers which were held in Ottawa. I've even come close to winning a few.

Q: What kind of deck designs do you use?

A: My Junior 40 card decks are Light Side Echo Base Numbers and Dark Side Asteroids. I call my regulation 60 card Light Side deck "super cheese," because it used On The Edge so many times I can go through my deck twice before the game is over. For Dark Side, I use "Asteroids," which I feel is most flexible.

Q: What do you like best about this game? What do you like least?

A: The best thing about this game is, it's so fun, I could do it for a living. The thing I like the least is how risky it is to play the usual light decks like Mains and Toys, because of Epic Duel, and Dagobah, because of Ability Ability Ability.

A: I prefer Light Side because of the many strategies you can use and how it is so much easier to get your Force back than with the Dark Side.

Q: What are your favorite cards? Which cards do you fear the most?

A: Favorite cards are On The Edge and Trample. You can build a very mean deck around them. I'm even called "Crazy On-The-Edge Boy" due to my frequent use of the card.

The cards I fear the most are Monnok and Grimtash. Have you ever lost the cards you needed most, like a Traffic Control, and then you're stuck with cards that are useless without it?
